QUOTE: With `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` off, the guarded code is absent... "in the default configuration, the library runs no concurrency of its own and takes no locks."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the library creates no threads of its own by default, but it never says the pthread example compiles to a stub main under that condition. It lists `ssl_pthread_server.c` as a real multi-threaded consumer, which contradicts the item.
